description: Find the events worth going to in a city, a country or worldwide, ranked by how big a moment each is (a 0-100 score from expected crowd and timing) or by start time, optionally only those matching a name (an artist, team, show or venue). Covers concerts, sport, festivals, nightlife, culture and city moments, merged from ticketing, sports and open-data feeds and refreshed every two hours. Use it for questions like "what's on in Lisbon this weekend", "biggest concerts in London this week", "when are Arsenal at home" or "is Coldplay playing in Europe". Each result has the local date and time, venue, score with a one-line reason, and a link to the event's page.

categories.description: Only these kinds of events. Omit for all.

city.description: City name in English, e.g. "London", "New York", "Mexico City". Add the country after a comma when a name is shared ("Paris, France"). Omit city and country for worldwide. For the major cities, results also include the big events just outside the city line (SoFi Stadium in Inglewood for Los Angeles, MetLife Stadium for New York); each result names its own town.

country.description: A whole country instead of one city: English name or ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code ("Netherlands", "NL"). Ignored when city is given.

query.description: Only events whose title or venue contains this text: an artist, team, show or venue name, e.g. "Coldplay", "Arsenal", "Madison Square Garden". At least 2 characters.

sort.description: biggest: highest score first. soonest: earliest start first.

when.description: now: on right now. tonight: the rest of today, local time. this_weekend: Friday 17:00 to Sunday night, local time. this_week: the next 7 days. upcoming: the next 160 days.

name: search_events

board_url.description: The live board for this place on placetobe.cc.

area.description: Neighbourhood or area of the venue.

reason.description: One line on why it scores as it does.

score.description: How big a moment it is (expected crowd and timing).

source_url.description: The ticketing or official page the listing came from.

tier.description: The score as a word: Legendary, Hot right now, Rising, Notable or On the radar.

time_announced.description: False when the source published a date but no start time.

timezone.description: IANA time zone of the venue.

when.description: Local date and time at the event, e.g. 'Sat 3 Oct, 20:00'.

query.description: The name filter, when one was given.

scope.description: Where: a city, a country, or 'worldwide'.

title: Find events
